title: Roots Over Stone
summary: Beneath the Barsaebic Ayleid undercity of Stormhold, caravan factors and Tree-Minders clash when a stolen Shadow-Sign stone destabilises the sunken root-conduits.

hook.rumour: Caravanners at Stormhold's upper causeway say the Barsaebic vaults beneath the town are humming with cold blue light, and the Tree-Minders accuse the border factors of prying open a sealed Ayleid sluice.
hook.notice: STORMHOLD CAUSEWAY ASSIZE: Experienced delvers sought to inspect the Barsaebic undercity conduits and recover the missing Shadow-Sign birthstone.

npcs.name: Warden of Stormhold
npcs.greet: Caravanners at Stormhold's upper causeway say the Barsaebic vaults beneath the town are humming with cold blue light, and the Tree-Minders accuse the border factors of prying open a sealed Ayleid sluice.
talk: The trouble across Stormhold began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Stormhold.
If you mean to help the Stormhold Ring & Tree-Minders, start by checking the trail between Stormhold and Silyanorn Ruins.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Stormhold
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Silyanorn Ruins is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Silyanorn Ruins toward Glow Scale Encampment before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Stormhold so Tree-MinderNuxul can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Glow Scale Encampment
npcs.greet: You made good time from Silyanorn Ruins. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Vision of the Hist.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Vision of the Hist with a picked guard.
Once Vision of the Hist is cleared, return to Stormhold to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Stormhold
npcs.greet: Tree-MinderNuxul awaits word on whether the crisis in Stormhold has been contained.
talk: The elders of Stormhold have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Stormhold owes you a debt for standing between Stormhold and ruin.
